{"people":[{"name":"Priya","role":"Account executive (rep)","side":"us"},{"name":"PMM","role":"Product marketer (interviewer)","side":"us"},{"name":"Daniel","role":"VP of Engineering; signer","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed CFO","role":"CFO; joined one call for ten minutes","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed engineer (she)","role":"Engineer who built the weekend prototype","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed engineer (his engineer)","role":"Daniel's engineer at kickoff","side":"customer"},{"name":"unnamed account manager","role":"Competitor account manager, changed three times in two years","side":"competitor"}],
"competitors":["Braintree"],
"incumbent":"Not stated explicitly. Implied to be Braintree: the competitor account manager had changed three times in two years, the customer worried about losing PayPal/Venmo buttons, and saved cards had to be moved over.",
"evidence":[
{"id":"E1","turn":2,"excerpt":"They were launching Canada, then the UK, and sitters have to get paid locally.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Geographic expansion with local sitter payouts was the core trigger."},
{"id":"E2","turn":2,"excerpt":"a haunted house.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger","language"],"note":"Customer's own vivid description of their payments code."},
{"id":"E3","turn":2,"excerpt":"Two engineers more or less full-time just keeping sitter payments working.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Hedged estimate of maintenance cost. Source not stated."},
{"id":"E4","turn":2,"excerpt":"There was also a roadmap item, faster pay for sitters, that had been pushed three quarters in a row.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["trigger"],"note":"Delayed sitter-pay roadmap item was a secondary trigger."},
{"id":"E5","turn":4,"excerpt":"Daniel. He signed.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","outcome"],"note":"Signature identifies the decider and confirms the close."},
{"id":"E6","turn":4,"excerpt":"The CFO joined one call for ten minutes, asked one question","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Finance had minimal involvement."},
{"id":"E7","turn":4,"excerpt":"does this change when sitters get paid?","label":"quote","speaker":"CFO","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider","language"],"note":"Finance's only concern was sitter payout timing."},
{"id":"E8","turn":4,"excerpt":"this is an engineering decision, finance will sign what I bring them.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decider"],"note":"Engineering-led buying process, stated by the customer."},
{"id":"E9","turn":6,"excerpt":"Their account manager had changed three times in two years.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Competitor account churn was a customer complaint."},
{"id":"E10","turn":6,"excerpt":"I've stopped learning their names.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","language"],"note":"Customer frustration with the competitor's service relationship."},
{"id":"E11","turn":6,"excerpt":"A lot of pet owners pay with PayPal and Venmo, and they were nervous about what happens to those buttons.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting customer)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Customer raised PayPal/Venmo continuity as a switching risk."},
{"id":"E12","turn":8,"excerpt":"They had a call with Braintree in the middle of the evaluation. I know because the questions changed.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"The call is inferred from the changed questions, not directly confirmed."},
{"id":"E13","turn":8,"excerpt":"It went from \"how fast can we build this\" to \"what do we lose.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting customer questions)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Observed shift from speed to loss-aversion mid-evaluation."},
{"id":"E14","turn":8,"excerpt":"Do we lose PayPal, do we lose Venmo, what happens to the saved cards.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep (reporting customer questions)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor","gaps"],"note":"Specific switching-risk questions the customer asked."},
{"id":"E15","turn":8,"excerpt":"I assume Braintree told them they'd lose things. I don't know that. That's me guessing.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["competitor"],"note":"Rep explicitly flags a guess about competitor messaging."},
{"id":"E16","turn":10,"excerpt":"Reaction: the docs and the sandbox.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Developer experience landed."},
{"id":"E17","turn":10,"excerpt":"One of their engineers, on her own time, built a working sitter payment flow over a weekend and showed it at Monday standup.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"Self-driven prototype was the pivotal proof point."},
{"id":"E18","turn":10,"excerpt":"I didn't even know until Daniel told me.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","decided"],"note":"The deciding event happened outside the rep's visibility."},
{"id":"E19","turn":10,"excerpt":"And the marketplace piece. Onboarding sitters, the identity checks, paying out in local currency.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Marketplace onboarding and local payouts got a reaction."},
{"id":"E20","turn":10,"excerpt":"Silence: the acceptance-rate slide. I did the whole thing, the average improvement customers see.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message"],"note":"Auth-rate messaging fell flat."},
{"id":"E21","turn":10,"excerpt":"our average booking is 38 dollars, I'm not losing sleep over auth rates.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["message","language"],"note":"Low ticket size makes acceptance-rate value irrelevant to them."},
{"id":"E22","turn":12,"excerpt":"The weekend prototype. Before that it was a bake-off.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Rep's read of when the deal tipped."},
{"id":"E23","turn":12,"excerpt":"After that Daniel stopped saying \"if.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["decided"],"note":"Observed change in the decider's language."},
{"id":"E24","turn":14,"excerpt":"Nothing, really. It was a clean one.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Claims no gaps; contradicted by T16 and T18."},
{"id":"E25","turn":16,"excerpt":"We kind of danced around it.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Admits the PayPal/Venmo concern was not addressed."},
{"id":"E26","turn":16,"excerpt":"We said they could keep offering PayPal and we'd work through the details in implementation.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"PayPal answer was deferred to implementation."},
{"id":"E27","turn":16,"excerpt":"I didn't have a crisp answer on Venmo in the room, and I still don't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The Venmo gap remains open after the close."},
{"id":"E28","turn":16,"excerpt":"They decided it was a risk they'd take.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"Rep's characterization of how the customer accepted the gap."},
{"id":"E29","turn":18,"excerpt":"That one we handled.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Claim undercut by the unanswered reference request."},
{"id":"E30","turn":18,"excerpt":"We walked them through moving saved cards over so nobody has to re-enter anything. But it was a doc and a conversation.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Saved-card migration was supported only by a doc and a conversation, no proof."},
{"id":"E31","turn":18,"excerpt":"who's done this at our size without losing cards?","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","language"],"note":"Customer asked for a peer reference on card migration."},
{"id":"E32","turn":18,"excerpt":"I said I'd get back to him. I didn't.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"The reference request went unanswered."},
{"id":"E33","turn":20,"excerpt":"Once, in the kickoff.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps","outcome"],"note":"The card-migration concern persisted into kickoff."},
{"id":"E34","turn":20,"excerpt":"we'll find out.","label":"quote","speaker":"customer engineer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["gaps"],"note":"Customer is proceeding with the migration risk unresolved."},
{"id":"E35","turn":22,"excerpt":"Payments shouldn't be a team","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Repeated framing of the problem: payments as an overhead team."},
{"id":"E36","turn":22,"excerpt":"We want to stop babysitting this.","label":"quote","speaker":"Daniel (VP Engineering)","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language","trigger"],"note":"Customer's words for maintenance burden."},
{"id":"E37","turn":22,"excerpt":"paid by Friday","label":"quote","speaker":"customer","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"The customer's term for the sitter-pay promise."},
{"id":"E38","turn":22,"excerpt":"The whole promise to sitters is paid by Friday.","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Core brand promise to the supply side."},
{"id":"E39","turn":22,"excerpt":"Nobody there says \"marketplace.\" They say \"the app.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our category word is not theirs."},
{"id":"E40","turn":22,"excerpt":"And nobody says \"payouts.\" They say \"sitter pay.\"","label":"fact","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["language"],"note":"Our feature word is not theirs."},
{"id":"E41","turn":24,"excerpt":"Only that I barely sold this. Their engineer did.","label":"opinion","speaker":"rep","paraphrase":false,"topics":["outcome","decided"],"note":"Rep credits the customer engineer's hands-on proof over the sales effort."}
],
"contradictions":[
{"evidence":["E24","E25","E26","E27"],"what":"Rep says nothing was missing and it was 'a clean one', then admits they danced around PayPal and still have no Venmo answer."},
{"evidence":["E24","E29","E31","E32","E33","E34"],"what":"Rep says saved cards were handled and the deal was clean, but Daniel's reference request was never answered and the concern resurfaced at kickoff."},
{"evidence":["E12","E15"],"what":"Rep states as fact that a Braintree call happened, but the only basis given is the changed questions; what Braintree said is admitted guesswork."}
],
"dodges":[
{"question":"What did they ask for that we couldn't show?","turn":14,"what":"Answered 'Nothing, really', then under follow-up revealed the PayPal/Venmo gap and the unanswered saved-card reference request."},
{"question":"Earlier you said they were nervous about the PayPal and Venmo buttons. What did we show them on that?","turn":16,"what":"Nothing concrete was shown; the issue was deferred to implementation and Venmo remains unanswered."},
{"question":"Daniel's 'who's done this at our size without losing cards?' (customer question relayed at T18)","turn":18,"what":"Rep promised to get back to the customer and never did."}
],
"skipped":[],
"language_pairs":[
{"theirs":"the app","ours":"marketplace","evidence":["E39","E19"]},
{"theirs":"sitter pay","ours":"payouts / paying out in local currency","evidence":["E40","E19"]},
{"theirs":"paid by Friday","ours":"faster pay for sitters","evidence":["E37","E38","E4"]},
{"theirs":"auth rates","ours":"acceptance-rate","evidence":["E21","E20"]},
{"theirs":"haunted house / stop babysitting this / Payments shouldn't be a team","ours":"none stated in the pitch","evidence":["E2","E36","E35"]}
],
"outcome_signals":[
{"evidence":["E5"],"what":"Won: Daniel signed."},
{"evidence":["E33","E34"],"what":"The deal has progressed to kickoff, so implementation is underway."},
{"evidence":["E26","E27","E28"],"what":"Possible partial move: they 'could keep offering PayPal' and Venmo is unresolved, so some payment methods may stay outside our platform. Not confirmed."},
{"evidence":["E30","E31","E32","E34"],"what":"Saved-card migration risk is open post-sale, a potential implementation or retention risk."},
{"evidence":["E17","E22","E23","E41"],"what":"The win is attributed to the customer engineer's weekend prototype, not to the sales pitch."}
]}
